rationale: Archive INDIGO Park Canada as a standalone manager-level PortCo while preserving it as an active, distinct Canadian operating company beneath LAZ. Official accounts establish that LAZ completed a 60% acquisition on June 30, 2025, INDIGO Group retained 40%, and LAZ committed under the sale agreement to acquire the remaining 40% in 2029. Argo Infrastructure Partners' directly evidenced manager-level investment is LAZ, so the two current direct-looking Argo rows on INDIGO Park Canada are inaccurate. Preserve both rows only as inactive corrected audit history, with no economic exit year and explicit text that no separate direct position was established. INDIGO Park Canada and LAZ remain distinct legal identities, so no company merge or redirect is appropriate. Archive only the standalone record, preserve the company's operating and transaction history, and record the 2029 contractual transfer as a signed pending exit while keeping INDIGO Group's 40% as the current legal position in the supporting evidence until closing. The approved archive overlay removes INDIGO Park Canada from the evaluated manager-level seed list without changing the separately published LAZ record or the Deal Database.

afterImage.description: INDIGO Park Canada Inc. is a Montreal-based parking, mobility and EV-services operator active across Canada. Founded in Quebec City in 1988, the company remained a distinct legal and operating business after LAZ Parking completed a 60% acquisition on June 30, 2025; INDIGO Group retained 40%. INDIGO Group's FY2025 accounts state that LAZ committed under the sale agreement to acquire the remaining 40% in 2029, but the exact future closing date and valuation are not yet publicly fixed. The current company site reports more than 340,000 parking stalls across 95 cities and nearly 450,000 active app users. Argo Infrastructure Partners' directly evidenced manager-level investment is LAZ, not INDIGO Park Canada. INDIGO Park Canada is therefore archived from the standalone manager-level PortCo census as an active LAZ subsidiary, without a legal merge, redirect or Argo exit; the contractual 2029 ownership change remains pending.
